title: e1f-frame-rate-plan
description:
Design document (docs/E1F_FRAME_PLAN.md, Turkish, plan-only — no
production code) for package E1f: the optional target-fps picker the
E1 settings deferred (ExportSettings.kt wires frame rate as source-
only and promises the picker as a later package).
